title: sim-highline: curated galaxy scaling relations from cosmological simulations
description: Curated galaxy scaling relations (stellar mass function, main sequence, mass-metallicity, size, halo and black hole relations, UV luminosity function, cosmic SFR density and others) from cosmological simulations and observations, with the definitions that decide whether two curves are comparable, a provenance tier and citation on every record, and tidy CSV and JSON exports.
